nodes.norm_label: adr-16: live delivery decoupled from tracing

nodes.label: Authority-Aware Cross-Encoder Reranking
nodes.rationale: Prevents nonprecedential IRS pubs outranking controlling statute or binding opinions

nodes.label: Bounded 1-2 Hop Citation-Graph Traversal
nodes.rationale: Captures multi-hop legal reasoning decomposition alone misses, without full GraphRAG cost

nodes.label: Query Decomposition
nodes.rationale: Splits compound question into statutory, case-law, client-fact sub-queries plus as-of tax year

nodes.label: SSE Progress Stream over Durable Job Record
nodes.norm_label: sse progress stream over durable job record
nodes.rationale: Avoids proxy timeouts and lost jobs; answer never token-streamed before verification

nodes.label: CourtListener Rate-Limit Change (May 2026)
nodes.rationale: Free tier cut to 125/day; use quarterly bulk CSV for initial load, API only for weekly incrementals, GovInfo as supplement

nodes.label: Ingestion Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Format-specific parsers fan out to chunking/embedding, citation-edge extraction, bi-temporal tagging, authority tagging

nodes.label: Bi-Temporal Fact Validity (valid time + transaction time)
nodes.norm_label: bi-temporal fact validity (valid time + transaction time)
nodes.rationale: Answers both 'what was the rule on date X' and 'what did the system believe on date Y'

nodes.label: Open Questions (embedding, LLM provider, frontend, backup storage, market scope)
nodes.norm_label: open questions (embedding, llm provider, frontend, backup storage, market scope)

nodes.label: Renee (Enrolled Agent persona)
nodes.rationale: Sole named persona; 3-person practice, ~400 clients, spends 25-40 min per question cross-referencing sources

nodes.label: Build Phases A-H with Acceptance Gates
nodes.norm_label: build phases a-h with acceptance gates

nodes.label: TaxCite citation-grounded RAG system
nodes.rationale: Answers compound tax questions over statute, regulation, case law, IRS pubs and client docs; exists because generic LLMs hallucinate section numbers and paid seats are priced for larger firms

nodes.label: Goals G1-G6 (research time, seat displacement, groundedness, gates, cost, leakage)
nodes.norm_label: goals g1-g6 (research time, seat displacement, groundedness, gates, cost, leakage)

nodes.label: Cost Model & <$50/mo Budget Ceiling
nodes.rationale: Hard ceiling narrows LLM provider choice to self-hosted or budget tier; sub-answer caching is main lever

nodes.label: ADR-10: Batch sufficiency gate per sub-query
nodes.norm_label: adr-10: batch sufficiency gate per sub-query

nodes.label: ADR-12: Backup & DR for stateful stores
nodes.norm_label: adr-12: backup & dr for stateful stores

nodes.label: Shared Corpus + Per-Tenant Namespace Isolation
nodes.rationale: Storage/compute savings vs small blast radius, compensated by 0-tolerance leakage test

nodes.label: Eval Harness & Ablation Ladder
nodes.rationale: Isolates each mechanism's contribution rather than one aggregate score

nodes.label: Substantive Correctness (entailment != correctness)
nodes.rationale: LLM-as-judge replaces human review due to no labeling budget; judge must differ from generator, kappa >= 0.7

nodes.label: ADR-4: Self-hosted NLI, not LLM-as-judge, in production
nodes.norm_label: adr-4: self-hosted nli, not llm-as-judge, in production

nodes.label: Post-Generation NLI Claim Verification
nodes.rationale: Proves support, not legal correctness; production uses self-hosted NLI for cost/latency

nodes.label: Evidence-Sufficiency Gate
nodes.rationale: Runs before synthesis so unsupported content is never generated then retracted

nodes.label: Sanitized Rendering Contract
nodes.rationale: UI chips/badges only from structured ingestion fields so uploaded PDFs cannot forge trust signals
